_doc: Docking for repair in the main docking bay (M8-T06, D82). Lengths in metres, speeds in m/s, times in seconds; boxes in the station's frame (the bay's axis runs along +z into the drum; the drum, its pivot 1000 m forward of the station's middle, reaches from z -3576 to 1500 with the mouth at -3519.6, its ring and pylon inside the drum's box). dock_range_m: a fighter docks only at its own home dock (Combatant.home: the scenario's `home`, or the station whose Cobra bays launched it), and only while that dock's bay is within this range of it; farther out, with no home or with its home gone, it stays and fights and the wing's DOCK order is not offered. 60 km covers the station's own space out to its jumpgate. The player's docking shots are in docking_shots.json (M8-T31).

offer.line: BABYLON CONTROL: YOU ARE CLEARED TO DOCK FOR REPAIRS, MAIN DOCKING BAY

priority._doc: Fighters docking for repair take the bay before the station's traffic (maintainer, 2026-11-19). A fighter claims the bay on the lane, or on its approach within claim_within_m of the mouth. While one claims it, no civilian takes the lane, and one on the lane farther out than commit_out_m moves yield_off_m to its side and waits, then goes round to an entry point and comes in again; nearer in, or undocking, it goes on and the fighter waits wait_off_m below the lane, never on it.

wing_wait._doc: The player's wingmen break off while the player docks (maintainer, 2026-11-20): each goes to a stand-off beside the bow, clear of the docking lane, the cargo bay's and the Cobra bays' ways out: side_m to its own side of the lane (spacing_m more per slot), below_m below it and out_m off the mouth, in the station's frame. Under a hold-fire order it holds there and does not fire; under any other it fights what comes and stands by there otherwise.
